name: KPAX2_server
//: overrides.qs: express 4 and body-parser 1 pin qs to ~6.15, and 6.15.3 is the
last release of two advisories (array-limit bypass GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx, and
isBuffer DoS GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g) fixed in 6.16.0, which no express 4 release
requires yet. npm's only other remedy is `npm audit fix --force`, which
installs express 5 - a breaking change this app has not been moved to. The
query parser is what every request goes through, so the patched line is
forced for every dependant. Remove this once `npm ls qs` stops reporting
"overridden".
overrides.bson: kept from #12, where it closed the deserialization criticals
without moving the driver. mongodb 3.7.4 already resolves bson 1.1.6 on its
own, so it is redundant now rather than wrong - left in place because it is a
security floor and removing one should be a deliberate decision, not a side
effect of a merge.
morgan: 1.12.0 closes GHSA-jxfw-x594-9x9m, log forging through unescaped
Unicode line separators in the access log. Advisory published after this
branch opened, so it is a deliberate bump here rather than part of the merge.
overrides.qs is inherited from #12 and is now redundant: express 4.22.3 and
body-parser 1.20.8 require qs ~6.16.0 themselves, so the patched line resolves
without it. Left in place deliberately - removing a security override is
master's call, not a driver PR's.
